bicepsEase.name: Biceps ease (%)
bicepsEase.help: The amount of ease at your upper arm. Note that while we try to respect this, fitting the sleeve to the armhole takes precedence over respecting the exact amount of ease.

chestEase.name: Chest ease (%)
chestEase.help: Controls the amount of ease at the chest

collarEase.name: Collar ease (%)
collarEase.help: The amount of ease around your neck

cuffEase.name: Cuff ease (%)
cuffEase.help: The amount of ease at your wrist.

shoulderEase.name: Shoulder ease (%)
shoulderEase.help: The amount of ease at your shoulder. This increases the shoulder to shoulder distance to accommodate additional layers or thickness.

hemEase.name: Hem ease (%)
hemEase.help: The amount of ease at the hem.

sleeveBend.name: Sleeve bend (°)
sleeveBend.help: Controls the bend of the sleeve at the elbow.

lengthBonus.name: Length bonus (%)
lengthBonus.help: The amount to lengthen the garment. A negative value will shorten it.

s3Collar.name: Shoulder seam shift: collar side (%)
s3Collar.help: Increase this option to shift the shoulder seam forward on the collar side. Decreasing it shifts it backwards.

s3Armhole.name: Shoulder seam shift: armhole side (%)
s3Armhole.help: Increase this option to shift the shoulder seam forward on the armhole side. Decreasing it shifts it backwards.

neckDrop.name: Neck drop (%)
neckDrop.help: The amount the front of the neck will drop.

shoulderShift.name: Shoulder shift (%)
shoulderShift.help: This controls how far the shoulder seam is shifted to the front.

waistAdjustment.name: Waist/Hips adjustment
waistAdjustment.help: Adjusts the bottom of the denim jacket to match the hips measurement.

fullBustAdjustment.name: Full Bust Adjustment
fullBustAdjustment.help: Tries to adjust the jacket to better fit a full bust.

frontPocket.name: Front pocket
frontPocket.help: Enable this option to create a front pocket

yokeDrop.name: Yoke drop (%)
yokeDrop.help: How far the yoke will drop down. Percentage of back neck-to-waist.

sleeveLengthBonus.name: Sleeve length bonus (%)
sleeveLengthBonus.help: The amount to lengthen the sleeve. A negative value will shorten it.

acrossBackFactor.name: Across back factor (%)
acrossBackFactor.help: Controls your across back width as a factor of your shoulder to shoulder measurement.

armholeDepth.name: Armhole depth (%)
armholeDepth.help: Controls the depth of the armhole

armholeDepthFactor.name: Armhole depth factor (legacy) (%)
armholeDepthFactor.help: Controls the depth of the armhole. Higher values make a deeper armhole. This option only applies to the legacy (v2) way of calculating the armhole depth.

backNeckCutout.name: Back neck cutout (%)
backNeckCutout.help: Controls how deep the neck is cutout in the back

frontArmholeDeeper.name: Front armhole extra cutout (%)
frontArmholeDeeper.help: How much do you want the front armhole to be cut out deeper than the back.

shoulderSlopeReduction.name: Shoulder slope reduction (%)
shoulderSlopeReduction.help: The amount by which the shoulder slope is reduced to allow for shoulder padding.

legacyArmholeDepth.name: Legacy armhole depth
legacyArmholeDepth.help: Enable this option to use the legacy way to calculate the armhole depth (using biceps circumference) rather than the v3 way (using the waist to armpit measurement)

sleevecapHeight.name: Sleevecap height (%)
sleevecapHeight.help: Controls the height of the sleevecap.

sleevecapEase.name: Sleevecap ease (%)
sleevecapEase.help: The amount by which the sleevecap seam is longer than the armhole seam.
